newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Perm region to issue bonds in summer.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Perm region to issue bonds in summer.

text.p: Russia's Perm region, located in the Urals, plans to issue bonds to pay wages to teachers between June and August this year, the head of the local administration's finance department said on Wednesday.
"It will be by the time we have to pay holiday money to teachers," Mikhail Panfilov told Reuters.
The volume of the issue will tentatively be 100 billion roubles, divided into five issues and placed among corporate bodies, he said. The tenor will vary from six months to one year.
"Paper with a longer maturity is unlikely to be purchased," Panfilov said.
He said the interest on the bonds would be tied to current GKO discount Treasury bills yields.
